This '''clone trooper''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the course of the war, he served with the [[85th Infantry Brigade]]. While he was stationed on [[Haurgab]] during [[Battle of Haurgab|one]] of the many battles in the clone wars, he was wounded when a [[Huntmaster missile|missile]] scored a direct hit on the [[Hadde Base|base]] he was currently located at.<ref name="O66" />

==Biography==
This [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. He was assigned to the 85th Infantry Brigade and participated in the Battle of Haurgab around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. This trooper was in the [[Cantina/Legends|mess]] at the [[Hadde Base|base]] when a group of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|pro-Separatist]] launched a missile strike from within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-friendly [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hadde]]. One missile directly hit the front entrance, and the resulting explosion flung metal trays from a rack across the room, striking the trooper and one of his [[Unidentified clone trooper (Haurgab)|comrades]]. Due to the fact he was in his fatigues, one of the trays cut off one of his legs at the knee. The other trooper was less lucky and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when a tray cut the top part of his head off.<ref name="O66" />
